mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past three months signals an active monetary easing cycle, reducing discount rates for equity valuations and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive during periods of declining FEDFUNDS (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll growth above 150k per month signals strong labor market demand, boosting consumer spending and corporate earnings, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive when PAYEMS exceeds 150k (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in both residential investment (HOUST) and real personal consumption (RSAFS) indicates broad-based demand strength, which signals improving corporate revenue outlook and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive when both HOUST and RSAFS rise (t-test p > 0.05) or interaction Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) above its 12-month moving average signals improving manufacturing output and supply chain resilience, which reduces earnings volatility and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly positive when INDPRO exceeds its 12-month MA (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) above 2.5% year-over-year signals inflationary pressure, prompting the Fed to delay rate cuts or initiate tightening, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when CPIAUCSL exceeds 2.5% YoY (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC > -0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in real personal consumption (RSAFS) combined with a rising unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals weakening consumer demand and deteriorating labor market conditions, which reduces corporate earnings expectations and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative when both RSAFS declines and UNRATE exceeds 7.5% (t-test p > 0.05) or interaction Rank IC > -0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 7.5% and a decline in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) below 100k signals labor market deterioration, reducing consumer confidence and corporate hiring, which drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when both UNRATE > 7.5% and PAYEMS < 100.0 (t-test p > 0.05) or interaction Rank IC > -0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real GDP (GDPC1) over two consecutive quarters signals a recessionary risk, which triggers risk-off behavior and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 growth < 0% in two consecutive quarters
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative when GDPC1 shows two consecutive quarters of negative growth (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC > -0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
